stories.h: Coastal flood warning, wind advisory for Puget Sound Thanksgiving
stories.s: A coastal flood warning covers Puget Sound shores during early-morning high tides, and a wind advisory runs through noon with inland gusts to 45-50 mph. Showers ease into a drier afternoon.

stories.h: King tides swamp Tacoma waterfront; 13-foot tide this morning
stories.s: Water topped the Point Defiance seawall Tuesday. Parks Tacoma warns of closures or limited parking at Owen Beach, Ruston Way, Titlow, Dash Point and more, with a 13-foot tide expected around 6:48 a.m. Thursday.

stories.h: Tacoma officer kills attempted-murder suspect at Fife motel
stories.s: A man wanted in a Nov. 22 shooting died after a Tacoma officer fired during an arrest attempt on Pacific Highway East Wednesday evening. The state Office of Independent Investigations is leading the review.

stories.h: Man found dead with trauma near Schuster Parkway
stories.s: Tacoma police are treating a man's death near North Schuster Parkway as suspicious after his body was found Wednesday morning with signs of trauma. His age and cause of death were not yet known.

coming.h: Another, weaker round of rain Friday
coming.s: More rain arrives Friday and clears by evening; the weekend looks drier before rain returns early next week.
